key: organisation_number (the company; for food inspections the parent enhet of the inspected underenhet per Enhetsregisteret, or the enhet itself)

brreg.text: Sub-unit to parent mapping from Enhetsregisteret (Brønnøysundregistrene), NLOD 2.0.

food_inspection.text: Mattilsynet smilefjes inspection data (Smilefjestilsyn på serveringssteder). Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 per the national data catalogue (https://data.norge.no/datasets/288aa74c-e3d3-492e-9ede-e71503b3bfd9). Mattilsynet withdraws invalidated inspections from the open data and asks users to refresh daily.

research_grant.text: Forskningsrådet open data 'Søknader - versjon 2' (https://github.com/Forskningsradet/open-data). Licence: NLOD 2.0 per the national data catalogue (https://data.norge.no/datasets/349766ba-b5fd-3a04-8d82-77ec8928d6f2); the GitHub repository has no LICENSE file. Excludes applications in the new case system Tibi.

skattefunn.text: SkatteFUNN application lists, Norges forskningsråd. Licence: Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD) 2.0 per the national data catalogue entry 'Innsendte søknader til Skattefunn' (https://data.norge.no/datasets/f82d3d4a-b0f8-3220-83ef-15fbd854c54f). The download page itself states no licence.

name: public_records
notes: SkatteFUNN status: Godkjent/Søknad godkjent JA -> approved; NEI (or Søknad avslått JA) -> rejected; empty -> no_decision_recorded. date = Søknadsdato/Innsendt dato, decision_date = Vedtaksdato.

Forskningsrådet status from prosjektfase: Bevilgning -> granted, Avsluttet -> completed, Avslag -> rejected, Vurderes -> under_review, Mottatt -> received. amount = tildelt_belop verbatim, only for granted/completed projects with a positive amount (total for the whole project period). The file does not state a currency; Forskningsrådet amounts are NOK.

Food inspections: grade = total_karakter as given (0/1 smile, 2 straight mouth, 3 sad mouth per Mattilsynet's documented scale). Inspections at units that are deleted from Enhetsregisteret (no parent provable) are dropped. Mattilsynet withdraws invalidated inspections, so rebuild daily.
raw_cells: original cell values used, as strings (xlsx dates as read by openpyxl, ISO-8601).
summary: verbatim popular-science summary, cut to <= 600 characters at a word boundary (summary_truncated=true when cut; no ellipsis added).
record_id: skattefunn:soknad:<Søknadsnummer> (new system), skattefunn:prosjekt:<Prosjektnummer> (2002-2024 file), forskningsradet:<prosjektnummer>, mattilsynet:<tilsynid>.
Person fields (project leader names, gender) are never stored.
